name: Lord Valthalak Laid to Rest
how: Complete the Dungeon Set 2 / Lord Valthalak quest chain, running from 'An Earnest Proposition' to 'Saving the Best for Last'.

name: Explore Azeroth
how: Have any character earn the Explore Azeroth achievement, which needs every Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor zone explored, including new zones such as Riverglades, Shen'dralas and Mount Hyjal.

name: Played in the WoW: Forever Beta
how: Listed as a challenge on the wiki for taking part in the beta. Its point value isn't stated, and it isn't part of the 65 launch points.

name: Novice Spelunker
how: Clear the low-level dungeon group: Ragefire Chasm or Hall of Thanes, Ruins of Lordaeron, Wailing Caverns, Deadmines, Shadowfang Keep and Excavation Site: Wetlands.

name: Experienced Spelunker
how: Clear the mid-level dungeon group: City of Dalaran, Blackfathom Deeps, Gnomeregan, The Drowned City, all Scarlet Monastery wings, Razorfen Kraul and Krol'dok Stronghold.

name: Master Spelunker
how: Clear the high-level dungeon group: Razorfen Downs, Uldaman, Zul'Farrak, Maraudon, Alcaz Prison, Sunken Temple, BRD, Blackmaw Hold, LBRS/UBRS, Scholomance, Stratholme, Dire Maul and The Shaper's Terrace.

name: Conqueror of the Wilds
how: Kill every boss in the Hyjal Summit raid.

name: Conqueror of the Deeps
how: Kill every boss in the Barrow Deeps raid.

name: Conqueror of the Lair
how: Kill Onyxia in Onyxia's Lair.

name: Holstered Replica Ironforge Air Rifle
how: Reach 15 total Legacy Points on your account, then claim it from Innkeeper Wiley in Ratchet. Toy for an opt-in shootout. It only stuns other players who are also holding the rifle, and it counts your hits. Account-wide.

name: Spectral Bear Cub
how: Reach 25 total Legacy Points on your account, then claim it from Innkeeper Wiley in Ratchet. Companion pet. Account-wide.

name: Spectral Bear Tabard
how: Reach 40 total Legacy Points on your account, then claim it from Innkeeper Wiley in Ratchet. Tabard. Account-wide.

name: Reins of the Spectral Bear
how: Reach 55 total Legacy Points on your account, then claim it from Innkeeper Wiley in Ratchet. Ground mount with 100% movement speed. Account-wide.

name: Professions Legacy Tree
points: up to 25 per tree; 16 spendable per character at launch
how: Covers tradeskill and gathering bonuses. Points are earned account-wide, but each character spends its own and can respec at a class trainer.

name: Adventure Legacy Tree
points: up to 25 per tree; 16 spendable per character at launch
how: Covers leveling, travel and out-in-the-world bonuses. Points are earned account-wide, but each character spends its own and can respec at a class trainer.

name: Resourcefulness Legacy Tree
points: up to 25 per tree; 16 spendable per character at launch
how: Covers food, death, reputation, honor and reagent savings. Points are earned account-wide, but each character spends its own and can respec at a class trainer.

name: Working Overtime
how: Professions tree perk. Each rank adds 4% to your chance of a skill-up from any primary, secondary or class tradeskill.

name: Bountiful Harvest
how: Professions tree perk. Gathering through Mining, Herbalism or Skinning yields more scarce materials, up to 20%.

name: Bartering
how: Professions tree perk. Vendors charge 5% less gold.

name: Performance Bonus
how: Professions tree perk. When you hand in crates to the Azeroth Commerce Authority or Durotar Supply and Logistics, gives a 5% chance to double the Merchant's Favor you earn.

name: Master Chef
points: 1 rank per wiki; 5 per Warcraft Tavern
how: Professions tree perk. Gives cooking recipes a 10% chance to make an extra item.

name: Dedicated Study
how: Professions tree perk. Ability on a daily cooldown that adds one point to your lowest primary or secondary tradeskill. Once all five are at 300, it gives 2-4 random Elemental Essences instead.

name: Luremaster
how: Professions tree perk. With a lure active, you have a 25% chance to catch a bonus fish.

name: Well Rested
how: Adventure tree perk. Rested XP builds faster and its cap is higher, by 4% per rank.

name: Thrill of Adventure
how: Adventure tree perk. Killing blows on non-trivial foes restore 1% of your health and mana over 10 seconds. Open world only.

name: High Alert
how: Adventure tree perk. Detect stealth as if you were one level higher. Doesn't work in battlegrounds.

name: Talented
how: Adventure tree perk. Talent points start earlier than level 10, as early as level 5 at full rank. The 51-point cap stays.

name: Field Guide
how: Adventure tree perk. Shortens the cooldown on adding camp features by 8%.

name: Field Medicine
how: Adventure tree perk. Cuts 5 seconds off the Recently Bandaged debuff. Open world only.

name: Frequent Flier
points: 3 ranks per wiki; 1 per Warcraft Tavern (needs Field Guide)
how: Adventure tree perk. Flight paths cost half as much and fly 20% faster.

name: Gourmand
how: Resourcefulness tree perk. Food buffs last 33% longer.

name: The Quick and the Dead
how: Resourcefulness tree perk. Move 5% faster while dead. For 1 minute after resurrecting, or until combat, helpful spells cost nothing.

name: Reinforce
how: Resourcefulness tree perk. Lose 8% less durability when you die.

name: For Great Honor
how: Resourcefulness tree perk. Earn 2% more honor.

name: Permanence
how: Resourcefulness tree perk. Long class party/raid buffs and camp resting benefits last 50% longer.

name: Diplomat
how: Resourcefulness tree perk. Earn 2% more reputation.

name: Reagent Economy
points: 1 rank (needs The Quick and the Dead)
how: Resourcefulness tree perk. Class abilities no longer use vendor-bought reagents.

name: Unrevealed Professions perks (2)
how: The Professions tree has two hidden perk slots that Blizzard plans to reveal later.

name: Unrevealed Adventure perks (2)
how: The Adventure tree has two hidden perk slots that Blizzard plans to reveal later.

name: Unrevealed Resourcefulness perks (2)
how: The Resourcefulness tree has two hidden perk slots that Blizzard plans to reveal later.
